queries.search_text: site:ure.gov.pl 2025 odmowy przyłączenia OZE sieci raport 2024 liczba warunki przyłączenia
queries.source_title: Akcelerator, Cyfrowy Bliźniak, aukcja dla morskiej energetyki wiatrowej i pierwsze decyzje tworzące rynek wodoru - Sprawozdanie z działalności Prezesa Urzędu Regulacji Energetyki w 2025 r. już dostępne
queries.proposition: URE reports 4,897 refusals of electricity-grid connection conditions in 2025 covering 107,000 MW, while also identifying flexibility services, dynamic-price tariffs, and network-law changes as active mechanisms; this supports a material grid-access and coordination bottleneck but not private willingness to pay for any proposed service.
queries.status: Official current evidence supports the bottleneck and available route-around mechanisms; buyer budgets and attainable margins remain unknown.
queries.contradiction: The refusal count fell year over year and aggregate refused capacity can include overlapping or speculative applications, so it is not equivalent to unique bankable demand.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Interview five Wielkopolska renewable installers and request ten anonymized 2025 refusal or rework cases, then pre-sell one fixed-fee application audit or flexibility study before building software.

queries.search_text: site:nik.gov.pl 2025 kolejki świadczenia zdrowotne nieodwołane wizyty raport NFZ Polska
queries.source_title: Funkcjonowanie NFZ - zdrowie drożeje, dostęp maleje, a budżet... kuleje!
queries.proposition: NIK found persistent geographic gaps, worsening waits, weak live monitoring, and large regional disparities in Polish publicly funded care; this supports opportunities around capacity visibility, navigation, and provider operations but does not establish payment demand.
queries.status: Official audit evidence supports access and information failures; current local availability, procurement pathways, and payer conversion remain unknown.
queries.contradiction: NIK also attributes the problem to constrained NFZ finances and contracting, so information or workflow tools alone may not create clinical capacity.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Use public queue data and ten provider calls to map one specialty in two Wielkopolska counties, then ask one clinic, employer, or diagnostic operator to pay for a manually delivered capacity and referral-flow pilot.

concepts.title: Grid Application Preflight for Renewable Installers
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A rules-and-evidence preflight service can catch incomplete or technically implausible grid applications before installers submit them, reducing rework and lost projects without pretending to guarantee connection.
concepts.customer: Small and mid-sized Polish PV, storage, and heat-pump installers submitting generation or storage connection applications
concepts.loss_event: A viable sale stalls or dies after an avoidable application defect, unsupported sizing choice, or missed operator requirement
concepts.beneficiary: Installer, project owner, and engineering subcontractor
concepts.authority_holder: The relevant distribution or transmission system operator
concepts.distributor: Renewable-equipment wholesalers, installer associations, and the founder's family installation network
concepts.risk_bearer: Installer retains project and approval risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The preflight service invoices the installer per reviewed application
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee human-assisted review of one real application pack
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer white-label reviews through one Wielkopolska equipment wholesaler and direct outreach to installers with recent refusals
concepts.compounding_asset: An anonymized corpus linking operator, topology, requested configuration, defects, amendments, and outcomes
hypotheses: A meaningful share of failed or delayed applications contains preventable defects rather than only hard capacity constraints
Installers will pay before submission to protect sales-cycle time
Operator-specific requirements can be maintained without representing the service as legal or engineering approval
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not promise, imply, or procure preferential grid treatment, and must not fabricate technical documents or operator communications.

concepts.title: Cable-Pooling Counterparty Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A structured discovery and diligence desk can match underused grid-connection holders with complementary renewable or storage projects and earn for verified introductions and document rooms.
concepts.customer: Subscale renewable developers and owners of operating projects with potentially shareable connection capacity
concepts.loss_event: A new project cannot secure an economical connection while an existing connection is underused at complementary times
concepts.payer: The incoming developer, with an optional listing fee from the connection holder
concepts.beneficiary: Both project counterparties and their capital providers
concepts.authority_holder: Connection holder, land and project owners, and the relevant system operator for required approvals
concepts.distributor: Energy lawyers, independent engineers, project-finance advisers, and renewable associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Project counterparties retain permitting, technical, financing, and curtailment risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The desk controls the diligence workspace and invoices a fixed mandate fee plus a disclosed closing fee
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid counterparty search with minimum technical and title verification
concepts.acquisition_route: Start with regional solar owners and storage developers reached through installation and engineering partners
concepts.compounding_asset: A permissioned map of connection rights, hourly utilization shapes, technical compatibility, and completed deal terms
hypotheses: A sufficient pool of holders can lawfully share verified connection information
Complementary generation or storage profiles create financeable projects after operator review
Developers will pay for a trusted counterparty process despite long transaction cycles
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not trade connection rights as if freely transferable, bypass operator consent, misuse confidential grid data, or conceal conflicts between counterparties.

concepts.title: SME Flexibility Dispatch Cooperative
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A lightweight control and aggregation layer can combine flexible refrigeration, pumps, charging, and batteries at SMEs so they lower peak costs and become usable flexibility rather than passive grid load.
concepts.customer: Cold stores, farms, workshops, warehouses, and small manufacturers with controllable electrical loads
concepts.loss_event: The business pays avoidable peak and energy costs while flexible equipment sits uncoordinated
concepts.payer: Facility owner or tenant responsible for the energy bill
concepts.beneficiary: Facility, aggregator, and potentially the local network
concepts.authority_holder: Facility operator for equipment control and licensed or registered market actors where required
concepts.distributor: Electrical contractors, energy auditors, equipment service firms, and regional business associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Service provider bears performance-fee risk; facility retains process interruption risk under agreed limits
concepts.transaction_owner: The service contracts with the facility and shares verified savings or market revenue
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid two-week interval-data audit with a control-ready savings plan
concepts.acquisition_route: Bundle audits into existing electrical maintenance visits by the family installation firm and partner contractors
concepts.compounding_asset: Device-level response curves, site constraints, tariff outcomes, and dispatch performance by business type
hypotheses: SMEs expose enough safe flexible load to create savings after hardware and integration costs
A licensed partner can handle any regulated market participation initially
Owners accept bounded remote control when production constraints and overrides are explicit
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not act as an unlicensed electricity-market intermediary where authorization is required or override safety and production controls.

concepts.title: Storage Retrofit Proof Pack
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: An independent interval-data model can tell existing solar owners and their installers whether a battery, dynamic tariff, or control change is the cheapest response to export and price constraints.
concepts.customer: Commercial and agricultural owners of existing solar installations plus installers seeking retrofit sales
concepts.loss_event: A buyer overpays for a poorly sized battery or continues losing value through low self-consumption, peaks, or export limits
concepts.payer: Site owner, or installer purchasing a white-label assessment
concepts.beneficiary: Site owner and a credible retrofit vendor
concepts.authority_holder: Site owner for investment; operator and electricity supplier for metering, tariff, and connection conditions
concepts.distributor: Solar service calls, accountants serving farms, equipment wholesalers, and regional installers
concepts.risk_bearer: Buyer retains future price and equipment-performance risk; analyst warrants only model integrity
concepts.transaction_owner: The analysis service collects the fee before issuing the vendor-neutral proof pack
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-price analysis of meter data and three retrofit scenarios
concepts.acquisition_route: Use inverter-maintenance visits to offer an independent report before any hardware quote
concepts.compounding_asset: A benchmark library of load shapes, solar output, tariffs, degradation, quotes, and realized savings
hypotheses: Customers can export usable interval data without costly meter integrations
Vendor-neutral sizing increases conversion enough for installers to fund it
Realized savings can be measured and fed back into future models
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not manipulate assumptions to favor a hardware vendor or present forecast savings as guaranteed returns.

concepts.title: Renewable Connection Portfolio Triage
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A batch triage service for landowners and small developers can identify which early-stage projects deserve engineering spend, which need redesign, and which should be abandoned before sunk costs compound.
concepts.customer: Landowners, municipal companies, and small renewable developers holding multiple early-stage sites
concepts.loss_event: Scarce development capital is spread across low-probability sites until surveys, permits, and applications become unrecoverable sunk cost
concepts.beneficiary: Portfolio owner, co-investor, and downstream engineering firms
concepts.authority_holder: Portfolio owner makes stop/go decisions; public authorities and network operators retain permitting and connection decisions
concepts.distributor: Land agents, planning consultants, renewable engineers, and local-government advisers
concepts.transaction_owner: The triage firm sells a fixed-scope portfolio review and optional monthly update
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid desktop triage of five candidate sites using documented public and client-supplied inputs
concepts.acquisition_route: Approach land and planning intermediaries with a white-label pre-engineering screen
concepts.compounding_asset: A geospatial outcome set linking site attributes, operator responses, redesigns, elapsed time, and abandonment decisions
hypotheses: Early observable features separate obviously weak sites from those worth engineering
Portfolio owners will pay to abandon weak options earlier
Enough outcome data can be licensed or contributed to improve calibration
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not claim access to non-public grid capacity, guarantee an operator decision, or use unlawfully obtained land or network data.

concepts.title: County Specialty-Gap Intelligence
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A continuously refreshed county-level map of public queues, provider capacity, demographics, and referral leakage can help clinics choose defensible specialties and operating hours before hiring clinicians.
concepts.customer: Private clinic groups, diagnostic operators, and healthcare investors expanding outside major Polish cities
concepts.loss_event: A clinic hires scarce specialists or leases space in a market where accessible demand, reimbursement, or referral flow does not support the service
concepts.beneficiary: Clinic, clinicians, and underserved patients if capacity is added
concepts.authority_holder: Clinic management for launch decisions and NFZ or patients for purchasing care
concepts.distributor: Medical accountants, clinic-software vendors, recruiters, and healthcare property brokers
concepts.risk_bearer: Clinic retains launch, clinical, and contracting risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The intelligence provider sells territory reports and a monitoring subscription
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid specialty-and-county opportunity brief based on traceable sources and provider calls
concepts.acquisition_route: Direct outreach to multi-site clinics considering a second-tier-city location, supported by one sample Wielkopolska map
concepts.compounding_asset: A time series of queues, capacity changes, clinician supply, prices, referral patterns, and observed openings and closures
hypotheses: Public and permissioned data can be normalized accurately enough for county decisions
Private demand overlaps materially with measured public-access gaps
Clinic groups will pay before committing recruitment and premises cost
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not infer individual health conditions, re-identify patients, or present public queue gaps as proof of private purchasing intent.

concepts.title: Employer Wait-Threshold Care Navigation
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A navigation benefit can monitor public availability and arrange a transparent private alternative only when an employee's expected wait crosses an employer-set threshold.
concepts.customer: Employers and employee-benefit brokers serving staff outside the largest cities
concepts.loss_event: An employee remains untreated or repeatedly absent while searching fragmented public and private options
concepts.beneficiary: Employee, employer, and selected licensed provider
concepts.authority_holder: Employee controls consent and provider choice; employer controls benefit limits; clinicians control medical decisions
concepts.distributor: Payroll bureaus, occupational-health providers, and benefits brokers
concepts.risk_bearer: Employer bears benefit cost; employee and licensed provider retain medical decision risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The navigation service invoices a per-member fee plus a disclosed booking administration fee, never a hidden referral payment
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid 50-employee pilot for one specialty corridor
concepts.acquisition_route: Sell through one occupational-health clinic already serving regional manufacturers
concepts.compounding_asset: Consent-based availability, successful-routing, time-to-care, and return-to-work data by region and specialty
hypotheses: Employers perceive enough absence or productivity cost to fund navigation
Providers will expose reliable appointment inventory without exclusivity
Employees consent to limited data sharing when employer access to medical detail is blocked
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not sell patient referrals, jump public queues, disclose health data to employers, or steer care based on undisclosed provider compensation.

concepts.title: Endocrinology Pre-Visit Workup Bundle
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A physician-governed digital intake and local diagnostics bundle can make scarce endocrinology visits more productive by ensuring appropriate history and ordered tests are ready before consultation.
concepts.customer: Endocrinology clinics and telemedicine providers serving patients from high-wait regions
concepts.loss_event: A scarce specialist slot produces no decision because history or clinically appropriate test results are missing, forcing another long wait
concepts.payer: Clinic, or a patient purchasing a clearly separated private preparation package
concepts.beneficiary: Patient, specialist, clinic, and diagnostic partner
concepts.authority_holder: Licensed physician defines protocols and orders tests; patient provides consent and chooses care
concepts.distributor: Primary-care clinics, licensed laboratories, patient associations, and endocrinology practices
concepts.risk_bearer: Licensed provider bears clinical responsibility; service provider bears workflow and data-security responsibility
concepts.transaction_owner: A licensed clinic sells the care bundle while the workflow vendor invoices the clinic
concepts.first_paid_event: One clinic pays to run a manually coordinated 20-patient preparation pilot
concepts.acquisition_route: Recruit one endocrinologist and one laboratory partner, then enroll patients already booked for remote or private consultations
concepts.compounding_asset: De-identified protocol completion, repeat-visit avoidance, turnaround, and clinician-override outcomes
hypotheses: A material share of repeat visits is caused by missing information that can lawfully be prepared in advance
Specialists will adopt physician-approved structured intake without increasing uncompensated work
The bundle shortens time to a clinical decision without inducing unnecessary testing
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not diagnose, order tests, or give medical advice without licensed clinical authority, and must not induce medically unnecessary diagnostics.

concepts.title: Small-Clinic NFZ Contracting Evidence Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A productized evidence and submission desk can help credible small providers identify documented service gaps and prepare compliant NFZ contracting materials without relying on insider access.
concepts.customer: Independent specialist clinics, rehabilitation providers, and diagnostic practices considering public contracts
concepts.loss_event: A provider abandons a viable underserved location or submits a weak contracting package because procurement evidence and requirements are fragmented
concepts.beneficiary: Provider and patients in underserved areas
concepts.authority_holder: NFZ retains contracting authority; provider management authorizes bids and capacity commitments
concepts.distributor: Healthcare lawyers, medical accountants, clinic associations, and practice-management vendors
concepts.risk_bearer: Provider retains bid, staffing, and reimbursement risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The desk invoices fixed fees for gap analysis, readiness audit, and submission support
concepts.first_paid_event: A paid go-or-no-go assessment for one specialty and county
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner with two medical-accounting firms whose clients ask about NFZ contracting
concepts.compounding_asset: A versioned library of tender requirements, gap evidence, clarification outcomes, submission defects, and award results
hypotheses: Qualified small providers are deterred by process cost rather than solely by unattractive reimbursement
A repeatable evidence pack can reduce professional-service hours
NFZ opportunities occur frequently enough to support recurring monitoring revenue
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not promise awards, use non-public procurement information, coordinate bids, or misstate staffing, capacity, or patient access.

concepts.title: Mobile Diagnostics Route Underwriter
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: A demand-and-routing underwriter can help licensed mobile diagnostic operators choose recurring rural stops that fill genuine access gaps while meeting utilization targets.
concepts.customer: Operators of licensed mobile ultrasound, screening, sampling, and other diagnostic services
concepts.loss_event: A mobile unit travels to a low-yield location or misses a high-need corridor, wasting clinician and equipment time
concepts.payer: Diagnostic operator, municipality, employer, or sponsoring clinic
concepts.beneficiary: Operator, local host, referring clinicians, and patients
concepts.authority_holder: Licensed medical entity controls clinical delivery; local sponsor controls site access and purchased capacity
concepts.distributor: Municipal associations, occupational-health providers, pharmacies, clinics, and laboratory networks
concepts.risk_bearer: Operator bears utilization and clinical-delivery risk; underwriter bears only data and forecast quality risk
concepts.transaction_owner: The planning service sells a route study and recurring stop-performance monitoring
concepts.first_paid_event: A fixed-fee forecast and presale test for three candidate stops
concepts.acquisition_route: Approach one regional diagnostic operator with a prebuilt Wielkopolska corridor hypothesis and recruit local hosts only after operator interest
concepts.compounding_asset: A route-level dataset of inquiries, bookings, attendance, referral sources, service mix, seasonality, and repeat utilization
hypotheses: Measured access gaps predict paid or contracted diagnostic demand after local validation
Hosts can aggregate bookings without accessing unnecessary patient data
Recurring routes outperform one-off health events in utilization and trust
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not provide diagnostics outside licensed entities, overstate medical need, use sensitive data without consent, or substitute routing demand for clinical indication.
